subject: CFDictionaryRef<->NSDictionary*

observation.summary: Runtime probe creates a NSDictionary literal @{@"k": @"v"} and casts it as CFTypeRef; CFGetTypeID() returns 18, identical to CFDictionaryGetTypeID() (also 18). Identity is preserved.
observation.raw_output_excerpt: NSDictionary -> CFDictionary: ns=0x10076c168 cf=OK (id match? expected=18 got=18)

claim: On this host CFDictionaryRef is identity-preserved with NSDictionary* under __bridge cast and CFGetTypeID() matches CFDictionaryGetTypeID() (18), confirming the CFDictionary<->NSDictionary toll-free bridge.
